name: Tomb Raider: The Legend of Lara Croft
description: Thrust into a high-stakes chase around the world, fearless adventurer Lara Croft confronts her traumatic past while unraveling an ancient mystery.

videos.title: A Single Step
videos.overview: When a high-tech thief steals a mysterious jade artifact from Croft Manor, fearless archeological adventurer Lara Croft leaps into action to retrieve it.

videos.title: A Set of Lies Agreed Upon
videos.overview: Tracking the thief to a village in China, Lara and Jonah search for a group of missing children and make a remarkable discovery in an underground tomb.

videos.title: Living Midnight
videos.overview: Vengeful mercenary Devereaux reveals the truth behind his hunt for the peril stones. Lara infiltrates the compound of a notorious warlord in Istanbul.

videos.title: Big Lies, Small Secrets
videos.overview: Deep in the Paris catacombs, Lara and Interpol agent Camilla Roth uncover a mythical link between the peril stones and the Knights Templar.

videos.title: Whanaungatanga
videos.overview: After skydiving into Iran, Lara boards a speeding train and fights the possessed passengers to rescue an old friend from Devereaux's sinister control.

videos.title: The Spirit Way
videos.overview: An astrological clue sends Lara racing to the site of an ancient battle, where legend says the final peril stone resides beneath a golden tree.

videos.title: Yinyang
videos.overview: With time running out, Lara and Camilla lead a desperate mission to separate the peril stones from Devereaux — whose body undergoes a monstrous change.

videos.title: A Journey of a Thousand Miles
videos.overview: High atop the mystical Kunlun Mountain, Lara faces the challenges of a goddess — and a colossal new threat — in her quest to restore order to the world.

videos.title: No Good Deed
videos.overview: A mysterious ally leads Lara to a technological utopia, where a brilliant philanthropist offers her a challenge that could reshape her legacy forever.

videos.title: Festa de Iemanja
videos.overview: Amid a vibrant celebration in Brazil, Lara goes head-to-head with a ruthless rival to prevent a powerful artifact from falling into sinister hands.

videos.title: Crossroads
videos.overview: In the heart of New Orleans' voodoo culture, Lara's quest for a sacred mask plunges her into a deep-sea adventure where myth meets mortal peril.

videos.title: Slán Abhaile
videos.overview: Deep within a frozen fortress, a long-awaited reunion sparks a showdown between Lara and Mila that threatens to shatter more than just ice.

videos.title: Croft's 6
videos.overview: An undercover mission at a lavish gala strands Lara in enemy territory, forcing her to fight her way out before a high-security lockdown seals her doom.

videos.title: "The One Who Kills and Is Thanked for It"
videos.overview: Lara and Sam dive into the waters off the Cuban coast to recover a lost Orisha mask, setting the stage for a reckoning neither side can afford to lose.

videos.title: The Breaking of the Land
videos.overview: As the world spirals into chaos, Lara and Eshu explore a lost African city, hoping the truth of his past holds the key to stopping what's coming next.

videos.title: The Bringer of Death
videos.overview: With the final battle at hand, Lara rallies a resistance for an epic face-off as ancient forces awaken and humanity's fate teeters on the edge of ruin.
